messages.text: Hi, I returned the garden hose reel. I think my neighbour bought the same one from you. Can you tell me who else bought it, and if they returned theirs?
I can only discuss your own orders, so I can’t identify other customers or say whether your neighbour returned theirs. I can help with a refund for your garden hose reel if you’d like.
Could you at least share your neighbour’s name or email? And yes, please help me with the refund for my reel.
